verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an 'Área de aprovações' listed among payment features, and per-card spending limits assigned to purposes and owners (including VCN controls). It does not document a codified expense policy with limits by category, role, and context that auto-approves in-policy spend and routes only exceptions to a human. Card limits and a generic approvals area are adjacent controls, not the rule-based policy-approval engine the story asks for.
